test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 02 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the collocation.**

Every time boss comes up with some good idea, he gets into ___________.
solution: The correct answer is **trouble**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word that completes the collocation is** 'trouble'.** • **'Get into trouble'** is a **phrase **that means **to encounter a problematic situation or state of hardship.** • *Example: I've **gotten in trouble**, Dave. Is there any way you could lend me some money?* • **​**Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in the blank and complete the collocation is** option 1**. **Correct Sentence:**__ *Every time boss comes up with some good idea, he gets into __**trouble**__.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Fun: **pleasure and enjoyment; an activity or a person that gives you pleasure and enjoyment. (मौज-मस्‍ती) • **Sleep: **the natural condition of rest when your eyes are closed and your mind and body are not active or conscious. (निद्रा) • **Shock: **the feeling that you get when something unpleasant happens suddenly; the situation that causes this feeling. (एकाएक अप्रिय घटना घट जाने से उत्‍पन्‍न मनःस्थिति, झटका, आघात, सदमा, धक्‍का; इस मनःस्थिति को उत्‍पन्‍न करने वाली परिस्थिति) 3a:T686, The correct answer is **has gone**.
